title: Photo & Video: All Recovery
summary: Recover deleted photos, videos, messages, audio and files from your device.
description:
All Recovery is a powerful Android photo recovery tool designed to recover lost or deleted files. Whether you’ve accidentally deleted photos, videos, documents, or messages, All Recovery offers a fast and efficient way to recover deleted data. Easily scan your device, preview the results, and restore deleted files with just a few simple steps.

Key Features:
📸 Photo Recovery
Accidentally deleted precious photos? All Recovery helps you recover deleted photos from your device’s internal memory or SD card. The photo recovery process is quick, safe, and efficient, and you can preview the results to select only the photos you need.

🎬 Video Recovery
In addition to photo recovery, All Recovery also enables you to restore deleted videos in formats such as MP4, MOV, and MKV. Whether they were mistakenly deleted or lost due to storage issues, All Recovery scans, retrieves your deleted videos and cherish your memories once again.

💌 Message Recovery
No need to worry about losing important conversations. All Recovery lets you recover deleted messages from WhatsApp. It also helps recover deleted media files on WhatsApp, including images, audio, videos, and documents.

🗂 File Recovery
Whether it’s documents, audio files, or multimedia content, All Recovery can scan and restore any deleted files. It supports a variety of formats including PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPT, TXT, and more, ensuring no important file is lost.

🔍 Preview Before You Recover
With All Recovery, you can preview your deleted photos and files before deciding to restore them. This ensures you recover only the files you want, avoiding duplicates or unwanted data.

🛡️ Privacy and Local Operation
Your privacy is our priority. All Recovery operates entirely locally on your device, with no external server interaction. Your data stays secure, untouched, and fully under your control throughout the entire photo recovery process. All Recovery does not store or share your data.

⚠️ Limitations & Tips
Recovery results may vary based on device condition, Android version, and how long ago files were deleted. This app cannot recover:
• Files overwritten by new data
• Data lost after a factory reset
• Files stored only in cloud services (e.g., Google Photos, Drive, iCloud)
• Encrypted or securely erased data
👉 For best results, scan as soon as you notice data loss and avoid saving new files until recovery is complete.

Note:
All Recovery cannot guarantee 100% recovery of lost data, especially if the data has been overwritten or the device has undergone a factory reset. The sooner you use the app, the higher the chance of successful recovery.
